fact: Burundi Eco reports that the central bank's Regulation No 001/2019 on protection of consumers of financial products and services is in place and applies to licensed providers including electronic money issuers, per the BRB's head of financial inclusion.
The article headlines the Bank of the Republic of Burundi as arbiter between consumers and financial providers, and says the regulation seeks effective complaint-handling mechanisms at providers.

The Bank of the Republic of Burundi's circular of 29 May 2020 sets sanctions for breaches of Regulation 001/2019 on consumer protection for financial products and services, whose breach categories include digital financial services.
